roadmap.title: Modularize lookup.js
roadmap.why: Lookup remains the last major JavaScript monolith and is the highest-traffic page, but this work is intentionally postponed.

roadmap.title: Pro+ Data Center
roadmap.why: Every current and future data point belongs in one customizable sheet where a professional selects property, town, or county scope and checks the exact fields to add as columns.

roadmap.title: Exempt property and PILOT exposure
roadmap.why: Current abatement data covers only partial exemptions and can understate redevelopment exposure.

roadmap.title: Added and omitted assessment monitor
roadmap.why: Home improvements and omitted assessments can create unexpected tax changes outside the normal annual cycle.

roadmap.title: Municipal budget pressure
roadmap.why: Tax-rate history explains the past; budget and ratable-base pressure can explain what may drive the next cycle without pretending to forecast it.

roadmap.title: Farmland assessment qualification
roadmap.why: Farmland assessment rules and rollback exposure are valuable to rural owners, agents and attorneys.

roadmap.title: Appeal outcome logging and predictive foundation
roadmap.why: A defensible predictive model requires real parcel-level outcomes that public county data does not provide.

roadmap.title: Static town report landing pages
roadmap.why: Town Intelligence can support useful local search pages when each page has unique context and honest data limits.
